title: Advancing Weighted Partial MaxSAT Solving via Differentiable GPU Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2611.15091v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a GPU-CPU hybrid framework for Weighted Partial MaxSAT (WPMAX-SAT) that complements state-of-the-art CPU solvers with differentiable GPU optimization. The GPU stage directly optimizes instance-specific categorical decision parameters without a training dataset or a pretrained predictive model. The central challenge in extending differentiable optimization to WPMAX-SAT is the hard/soft clause asymmetry: hard clauses represent inviolable feasibility constraints while soft clauses carry weights. We introduce a hierarchical differentiable loss that prioritizes hard clause satisfaction before optimizing the weighted soft objective, ensuring that GPU gradient descent leans towards the constraint structure of WPMAX-SAT. translated_title: 通过可微GPU引导推进加权部分MaxSAT求解
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于加权部分MaxSAT（WPMAX-SAT）的GPU-CPU混合框架，该框架利用可微GPU优化来补充最先进的CPU求解器。GPU阶段直接优化针对特定实例的分类决策参数，无需训练数据集或预训练的预测模型。将可微优化扩展到WPMAX-SAT的核心挑战在于硬/软子句的不对称性：硬子句代表不可违反的可行性约束，而软子句则带有权重。我们引入了一种分层可微损失函数，它在优化加权软目标之前优先满足硬子句，从而确保GPU梯度下降遵循WPMAX-SAT的约束结构。我们的框架将GPU优化得到的变量logits转换为高置信度的赋值，并通过两种互补模式将其传递给CPU求解器：部分引导，它注入置信度最高的扰动变量赋值（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种GPU-CPU混合框架，通过无需训练数据的可微GPU优化和优先满足硬约束的分层可微损失，为最先进的CPU求解器提供高置信度赋值引导，从而推进加权部分MaxSAT问题的求解。
en_tdlr: A GPU-CPU hybrid framework advances Weighted Partial MaxSAT solving by using dataset-free differentiable GPU optimization with a hierarchical loss prioritizing hard clauses to provide high-confidence guidance to state-of-the-art CPU solvers.
